texts.pal: čē har kē-š xrad ast hunar-iz ast, čē har kē-š xrad ast xwāstag-iz ast, čē har [kē] kār nēk bun pad xrad wihēd.
texts.en: For he who has wisdom also has virtue; for he who has wisdom also has wealth.For he whose deeds are good lays the foundation wisely.

texts.pal: dārēm handarz-ē az dānāgān az guft ī pēšēnīgān, ō ašmā bē wizārēm pad rāstīh andar gēhān, agar padīrēd bawēd sūd ī dō gēhān.
texts.en: I have a counsel from the wise, from the sayings of the Ancient. To you [who are] in the world of life, I will state it, truthfully. If you accept it, you will have profit for both worlds:

texts.pal: pad gētīg fradom pad dēn āstawān būdan pad-iš warzīdār ud yaštār ud az-iš awardāg būdan, wurrōyišn menišnīhā pad weh-dēn ī māzdēsnān dāštan, sūd az zyān ud wināh az kirbag wehīh az wattarīh ud rōšnīh az tārīkīh ud māzdēsnīh az dēw-ēsnīh be wizīdan.
texts.en: In  this  world  first  a  man  should  be  steadfast  to  his religion, and  thereby  he  should  be  worker  and  worshipper  and he  should  not  turn  away therefrom,  thoughtfully  he  should keep faith  on  the  good  religion  of  Mazdā-worship,  and  should, distinguish  advantage  from  harm,  and  sin  from  good  deed and  goodness  from  wickedness,  and  light  from  darkness,  and Mazdā-worship  from  demon-worship.
texts.fa: به گیتی، نخست به دین خستو (= معترف) بودن [و] بدان ورزیدار (= عمل‌کننده) و نیایش‌کننده [بودن] و از آن روی‌گردان نبودن، گرویدن اندیشمندانه به دین مزدیسنان داشتن، سود از زیان، و گناه از کرفه، بهی از بدتری، و روشنی از تاریکی، و مزداپرستی از دیوپرستی گزیدن (= تمیز دادن).

texts.en:
On the day Hordād of the month Frawardīn, Frēdōn made the partition of the world.
He gave Rome to Salm and Turkestan to Tōz, Iran to Ērēč.
And he asked for the three daughters of Bōxt-Khosrow, king of the Arabs, and he gave them as wives to his sons.

texts.en: Receive traveling people well, so that you may be well received both here and there.
texts.fa: پذیرندۀ کاروانیان (= پذیرای مسافران) باشید تا در اینجا و آنجا شما را بیشتر پذیرند.

meaning_checks: Welcome travelers.
The purpose is to be well received both here and there; preserve reciprocity and both settings.

work_title: واژه ای چند از آذرباد مهرسپندان

texts.pal: pad petyārag hunsand ud pad astānag bārestān [bawēd], pad zīndagīh wistāx ma bawēd bē pad kunišn ī frārōn wistāx bawēd.
texts.en: Be content in adversity, patient in misfortune! Do not trust in life, but in good  actions!
texts.fa: نسبت به پتیاره (=بدی، بدبختی) خرسند (=شکیبا) و نسبت به نیاز بردبار [باشید]، به زندگی مطمئن مباشید بلکه به کنش (و کار) نیکو مطمئن باشید.

texts.en: Be content in adversity, patient in misfortune! Do not trust in life, but in good  actions!
texts.fa: نسبت به پتیاره (=بدی، بدبختی) خرسند (=شکیبا) و نسبت به نیاز بردبار [باشید]، به زندگی مطمئن مباشید بلکه به کنش (و کار) نیکو مطمئن باشید.

meaning_checks: Be content/patient in adversity and misfortune.
Trust good action rather than life itself; preserve the negative/positive contrast.

work_title: واژه ای چند از آذرباد مهرسپندان

texts.pal: ud āb ātaxš ud gāw ud gōspand ud sag ud sag-sardagān wināh abar ma kunēd kū-tān rāh ī wahišt ud garōdmān ō bastagīh nē rasād.
texts.en: Do not sin against water, fire, cattle, sheep, or dogs, and do not harm animals of the dog family, so that the road to paradise and Garōdmān may not be closed to you.
texts.fa: و بر آب، آتش و گاو و گوسفند و سگ و سگ‌سانان گناه مکنید که راه شما [به] بهشت و گرودمان به بسته شدن نرسد (= بسته نشود).

texts.en: Do not sin against water, fire, cattle, sheep, or dogs, and do not harm animals of the dog family, so that the road to paradise and Garōdmān may not be closed to you.

meaning_checks: Do not harm/sin against water, fire, cattle, sheep, dogs or dog-family animals.
The purpose is that the road to paradise and Garodman not be closed.

work_title: واژه ای چند از آذرباد مهرسپندان

texts.pal: pad kirbag kardan kē az dūr kē az nazdīk frāz rasēd dar wišādag dārēd čē ōy kē pad kirbag kardan dar wišādag nē dārēd ēg-iš dar ī wahišt ud garōdmān u-š be bandīhēd.
texts.en: When it comes to doing good deeds, keep your door open to whoever comes from near or from afar. For he who, when doing good deeds, does not keep his door open, will find the door to paradise and Garōdmān closed to him.
texts.fa: برای (= به منظورِ) کرفه کردن، کسی که از دور [و] کسی که از نزدیک فراز رسد، در را گشاده (= باز) دارید؛ زیرا آن کسی که به منظور کرفه کردن در را گشاده ندارد، پس درِ بهشت و گرودمان [بر] او بسته می‌شود.

meaning_checks: Keep the door open for doing good to arrivals from both far and near.
Failing to do so closes the door of paradise and Garodman to that person.
